data.stimulus: Press Agree to participate in the experiment.

Welcome to the Study!

In this study, you will complete 4 brief sessions, each featuring a different task.

Before we begin, please read the following scenario carefully.

Scenario:

Imagine you are working for a web design agency.
Your client, 280 Realty Group, has requested a web brochure for their newly opened condominium.
They have specifically asked for high-quality photos of their showrooms.
To meet this request, your photography team has prepared two sets of bedroom images,each featuring a slightly different style.

Please click the button below to view the instructions for Session 1

Session 1

Scenario continued:

Last night, the image folders of the two sets were acidentally merged...
The photography team has asked you to help sort the images back into their correct folders.
When asked about the style that defines each photo set, they mentioned it's difficult verbally, but they can indentify them visually.

Press 'e' for Set 1 and 'i' for Set 2

In this session, you will see multiple images one by one. For each image, you must decide which set it belongs to by pressing either 'e' or 'i'.

After each response, a photography staff member will provide feedback on whether you were correct or not. Based on this feedback, try to sort as many images correctly as possible.

Please try to respond as accurately and quickly as possible.
If you do not responded within 2 seconds, it will move on to the next image.

You will perform this task for 120 images over 5 rounds.

This is the end of round 1.
You have 1 more round(s) to go.
Take a break and press the button to proceed.

This is the end of round2.
Take a break and press the button to move on to the next session.

Session 2

Scenario continued:

You've successfully sorted all the images!
Next, the team needs to pick out the most memorable room photos for the brochure. To identify which ones are more memorable, they've designed a quick experiment.

This task will be repeated 171 times, with 4 breaks.
Before you begin, let's try 3 practice trials.
Practice is done. Now move on to the main trials.

This is the end of round 1.
You have 1 more round(s) to go.
Take a break and press the button to proceed.

This is the end of round2.
Take a break and press the button to proceed.

Session 3

Scenario continued:

While you were working on the experiment, the photography team finished preparing images of another bedroom. You'll now complete the same memory task using these new bedroom images.

You will repeat this trial 171 times and will be given 4 breaks.

This is the end of round 1.
You have 1 more round(s) to go.
Take a break and press the button to proceed.

This is the end of round2.
Take a break and press the button to proceed.

Session 4

Scenario continued:

The photography team asked you to sort out some images one more time.
These images are the bedrooms you just saw in the previous session. You can classify them based on the style you learned in the first session. This time, you perform this task without feedback.

Press 'e' for Set 1 and 'i' for Set 2

This session faollows the same procedure as Session 1

Please try to respond as accurately and quickly as possible.
If you do not responded within 2 seconds, it will move on to the next image.

You will perform this task for 18 images.
We are saving your data. Do not leave this page.
